summary: Confirm the existing repo-only exclusion. Andion migrated from Canada to Luxembourg, changed its identity to Andion CH4 Renewables and now presents itself as a European biomethane platform focused on Italy and the Nordic region. Equitix's 2026 direct release resolves continuing shareholder exposure: existing shareholders led by the Equitix Next Generation Fund made a material equity contribution to an approximately €70 million facility. Individual North American projects or legacy activity do not make the current manager-level platform North American.
modelEvidenceCorrections: Disposition corrected from DEFERRED to EXCLUDED because returned direct sources resolve both current Equitix shareholder continuity and European platform geography.
2026 financing corrected from €67 million to approximately €70 million.
